product_outline: Corner Trader: multi-asset trading platform (equities US/EU, CFDs, FX rolling spot, futures, options) via dxTrade5 web and mobile; multi-currency multi-account model with per-account currency and cross-currency conversion.
Integrations: external liquidity/STP where applicable; connectivity to bank backoffice for lifecycle and reporting; user and account data via REST from bank CRM systems.

Adaptive: mobile-oriented trading UI (iframe-capable), core dxTrade5 widgets (watchlist, positions, orders, order entry, portfolio, instrument detail/chart); single-leg focus on mobile with fuller web for advanced flows; same multi-asset architecture and sync model.
